aarti.tek: Victory to the Lord of Jānakī; victory to Śrī Rāma, Lord of the Raghus. With both hands joined I pray: Lord, hear my plea.
aarti.pad1: You are our Lord of the Raghus, our life, our father and mother; you alone are the companion of the good, the giver of devotion and liberation. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Cut away the round of the eighty-four lakh births and wipe out the terror of Yama. Lord, keep me night and day close to you alone. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Śrī Rāma, Bharata and Lakṣmaṇa are there, and with them their brother Śatrughna; a glittering light shines, taking on the greatest splendour. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Hanumān sounds his music, jingling his anklets; Mother Kausalyā performs the āratī with a golden platter. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: A lovely crown on his head, bow and arrow in his hands, his splendour is great. Manīrāma, beholding him, gives himself to him every moment. ॥5॥
